display_rows.description: Presentation-only projection containing Physical Leg subtotals, inheritance, blank cells, symbols, destination information, and separators.
display_rows.title: Display Rows

sections.description: Non-overlapping Calculation Zones and the sole source of truth for distance, time, and fuel totals.
sections.title: Sections

DisplayCellState.description: Meaning of one cell in the NAV LOG display projection.
DisplayCellState.title: DisplayCellState

FtdWeatherSettings.description: Deterministic weather inputs used for flight-training-device runs.
FtdWeatherSettings.title: FtdWeatherSettings

NavLogDisplayCell.description:
A formatted display cell with explicit blank/error semantics.

``text`` is the canonical value rendered by both Web and A4 output.
``effective_value`` may remain populated when ``state`` is ``INHERIT`` so
the projection records which parent/preceding value is used without
repeating it visually.

effective_value.description: Effective raw/canonical value, including values hidden by INHERIT.
effective_value.title: Effective Value

manual.description: Whether the effective calculation value came from a manual override.
manual.title: Manual

reason_code.description: Failure reason used only when state is UNAVAILABLE.
reason_code.title: Reason Code

state.description: DISPLAY_VALUE shows text; INHERIT and BLANK render empty; UNAVAILABLE renders a true acquisition/calculation failure; STATE_SYMBOL renders a presentation symbol such as an arrow.

text.description: Canonical formatted text shared by Web and A4 renderers.
text.title: Text

NavLogDisplayCell.title: NavLogDisplayCell

NavLogDisplayRow.description:
Presentation-only NAV LOG row projected from calculation zones.

``CalculationOutcome.sections`` remains the sole non-overlapping source of
truth for distance, time, and fuel.  These rows may contain display-only
subtotals, inheritance, symbols, separators, and destination reference
information and must never be used to recompute route totals.

counts_toward_totals.description: Legacy projection metadata only. Route totals must always come from CalculationOutcome.sections, never from display_rows.
counts_toward_totals.title: Counts Toward Totals

mh.description: Magnetic heading display cell. The calculation effective value is MC + WCA; transcription text adds the separately rounded 1-degree MC and WCA display operands.

row_type.description: Presentation row kind: Physical Leg subtotal, Calculation Zone, destination reference information, or visual Leg separator.
row_type.title: Row Type

section_id.description: Physical source Leg identifier; null for a pure separator row.
section_id.title: Section Id

source_result_sequence.description: Source Calculation Zone sequence used for editing/provenance only.
source_result_sequence.title: Source Result Sequence

zone_distance_nm_exact.description: Unrounded display-row zone/subtotal distance; never a totals source.
zone_distance_nm_exact.title: Zone Distance Nm Exact

zone_ete_seconds_exact.description: Unrounded display-row zone/subtotal ETE; never a totals source.
zone_ete_seconds_exact.title: Zone Ete Seconds Exact

NavLogDisplayRow.title: NavLogDisplayRow

true_course_deg.description: True course in degrees, normalized to [0, 360).

variation_deg_east.description: Magnetic variation in degrees with east variation positive.

wca_deg.description: Wind correction angle in degrees with right correction positive.
